sources.title: Pricing — Mako
sources.snippet: What exactly am I paying for? + AI model usage — that's it. The paid plans exist because frontier models cost real money to run. Every product feature is available on the Free plan and in the self-hosted version. What does 'included AI usage' mean? + Each plan includes a monthly budget of AI usage ($5 on Free, $80 on Pro).

sources.title: Meet Mako. A model built to operate the live web. - tinyfish.ai
sources.snippet: Today we're announcing Mako, a web-agent-native model purpose-built to operate the live web, trained on real task data collected from authenticated, multi-step enterprise workflows running in production. Mako is different from other web agent models. The models powering today's AI agents were built to do, well, everything.

sources.title: Download Mako Desktop — the whole platform, native
sources.snippet: Mako Desktop brings the AI-native data platform to your machine — including connections to localhost databases via the built-in Mako Agent. macOS, Windows, and Linux.
